definitions.explanation: A designated spot for viewing scenery, typically at scenic locations, parks, or tourist attractions.

examples.japanese: ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{展望所|てんぼうじょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最高|さいこう}→最高：02637_saikou⟧だった。
examples.english: The view from the mountain observation point was amazing.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{進|すす}む→進む：01225_susumu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{展望所|てんぼうじょ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: If you continue along this path, you'll reach an observation point.

examples.japanese: {展望所|てんぼうじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{双眼鏡|そうがんきょう}→双眼鏡：11981_sougankyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Binoculars are installed at the observation point.

notes:
Combines ⟦{展望|てんぼう}→展望：12393_tenbou⟧ (view/outlook) and {所|じょ} (place). A designated location for scenic viewing, found at mountains, parks, roadside rest areas, and other tourist spots. Often a simple outdoor platform rather than an enclosed building.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {展望所|てんぼうじょ}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{眺|なが}め→眺め：03502_nagame⟧: the view from the observation point
- {展望所|てんぼうじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand at the viewing platform
- {展望所|てんぼうじょ}⟦{案内|あんない}→案内：01291_annai⟧: observation point guide

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{展望台|てんぼうだい}→展望台：18278_tenboudai⟧: observation deck/tower — usually a built structure, often taller
- ⟦{見晴|みは}らし→見晴らし：15713_miharashi⟧{台|だい}: viewing platform — more casual, emphasizing the clear view
- ⟦{展望|てんぼう}→展望：12393_tenbou⟧⟦ロビー→ロビー：26995_robii⟧: observation lounge — an indoor viewing area
